selection: Exactly ten supplied keys in supplied order; no replacements
bootstrap: Case-only percentile intervals, fixed reference, patient resampling units; conditional uncertainty, selected findings
percentiles: 100*(count reference less than x + 0.5*count equal to x)/reference_n
loo: Every case omitted once, fixed reference, raw two-sided p only; no LOO BH or significance decisions

patient_consistency_score.2: at least 0.80 strictly beyond reference median in primary g direction

loo_robustness_score.2: all signs retained and maximum absolute g change <= 0.25*abs(primary g)
loo_robustness_score.1: all signs retained but relative change >0.25

normalization_interpretability_score.2: verified components on comparable aligned scale; both contributions quantified
normalization_interpretability_score.1: verified formula but geometric comparability unresolved

comparator_stability_score.2: reference varies, sign agreement>=0.95 and global q discovery frequency>=0.80
comparator_stability_score.1: reference varies and sign agreement>=0.95 only

cross_category_score.2: another eligible cell same direction with original global q<0.05 and no eligible opposite sign
cross_category_score.1: all other eligible cells same direction, none significant

clinical_interpretability_score.1: simple planar chin width/height or forehead width ratio; prior accepted QC but no independent landmark review
clinical_interpretability_score.0: hairline, eyelid/gaze, nasal vertical proxy or eyebrow area/lateral geometry vulnerable to pose/expression/landmark ambiguity
clinical_interpretability_score.2: requires independent clinical and landmark corroboration; not assigned in this task

ranking: score_earned/score_possible descending, then score_possible descending, then locked candidate rank; report denominators and completeness
outlier_flag: max LOO change >25% of abs(primary g), zero or negative boundary values, or nonfinite/missing
decomposition: Only actual stored raw components; never invert normalized ratios to invent components
optional_matching: Not run: optional additional design not prespecified; covariate compatibility reported, no forced matching
privacy: All real outputs in verified ignored local_review; no person-level plots or public release; aggregate robustness figure only
clinical_claim: Internal follow-up priority only; no novelty or independent clinical validation
